# Architecture decisions

One file per decision that is expensive to reverse. Immutable once accepted —
superseded by a new ADR rather than edited, so the reasoning history stays readable.

| -------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [ADR-0001](./0001-schema-per-workspace.md)                     | Schema-per-workspace for tenant isolation                                    | `accepted` | `src/server/workspace`, `src/server/db`                                  |
| [ADR-0002](./0002-single-app-not-monorepo.md)                  | Single Next.js app, boundaries enforced by lint                              | `accepted` | `src/components`, `src/server`, `src/shared`                             |
| [ADR-0003](./0003-exact-optional-property-types.md)            | Keep exactOptionalPropertyTypes, declare component props as `?: T            | undefined` | `accepted`                                                               | `src/components`, `tsconfig.json` |
| [ADR-0004](./0004-logical-properties-and-externalised-copy.md) | Logical CSS properties only, and copy passed into components                 | `accepted` | `src/components`, `src/shared`, `design-system`                          |
| [ADR-0005](./0005-dynamic-fields-typed-columns-plus-jsonb.md)  | Dynamic form fields — typed columns for statutory data, jsonb for custom     | `accepted` | `src/server/db`                                                          |
| [ADR-0006](./0006-spa-with-tanstack-query.md)                  | Client-rendered SPA on Next.js, TanStack Query as the data layer             | `accepted` | `src/app`, `src/components`, `src/shared`                                |
| [ADR-0007](./0007-module-colocated-with-its-routes.md)         | A module lives beside its routes; DB access is gated by file role            | `accepted` | `src/app/api`, `src/server`, `tooling/eslint-rules`                      |
| [ADR-0008](./0008-auth-is-infrastructure.md)                   | Auth is infrastructure; route handlers share one ingress wrapper             | `accepted` | `src/server/auth`, `src/server/http`, `src/app/api`, `src/middleware.ts` |
| [ADR-0009](./0009-platform-table-row-level-security.md)        | Row-level security on platform tables — scoped to unused tables, not blanket | `accepted` | `src/server/db`, `src/server/workspace`                                  |

## Writing one

Copy `0000-template.md`. Fill in the frontmatter — `affects:` is what creates the
back-links, so a decision with no `affects` reaches nobody. Write one when a boundary
changes, a hard-to-remove dependency is added, an invariant is amended, or someone asks
"why is it like this?" for the second time.
